text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, worked up a good sweat.
Let's keep this momentum going tomorrow too—hm?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, something feels off... Making a move
isn't something you can just do half-assed, right...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman said, 'Timing is everything
when using your special move,' too..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I don't get it at all!
If that's how it is, special training is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Looks like Biko is struggling with when to make her move."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy boy. Mind if I head over
and run alongside 'em for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Running with someone else is the best way
to learn when to make your move!
choice_data_list: Please go give them a hand.
Let's watch over them until they get the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty!
I can't just ignore a hardworking junior, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Practicing your timing for making a move, right?
If you don't mind me, I'll run alongside ya.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thanks, Big Sis Hishiama!
I couldn't really figure it out just running by myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! I'll keep you company for as long as it takes until you're satisfied, Biko.
Afterward, Hishi Amazon and Biko Pegasus continued their special training until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "True, maybe finding the answer on your own is more important than having someone hand it to you..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: True confidence comes from solving things with your own strength.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I think I'll head back to the dorm
and whip up some snacks to bring over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I at least want to let them know
that I'm cheering them on!
